verdict.rationale: Smithery has no explicit sandbox or test environment. Two features come close: Uplink lets a developer test a locally running MCP server against a real agent before publishing it, and namespaces act as separate workspaces with scoped API keys, which could keep testing apart from production resources. Neither is described as a sandbox that guarantees production data stays untouched. Missing for 10: a documented sandbox or test mode, explicit separation of test and production data or credentials, mock or test-account connections, and independent corroboration.
